About Valence

Built by operators.

A boutique supply chain partner in Los Angeles. We take on suppliers, inventory and freight as a small team that learns your business.

Why we started it

Companies got a big firm that treated them like a ticket, or software that left them alone. We built the partner in between.

Our operating system
